formula_extraction_warnings: The PDF is searchable, but mathematical expressions are sometimes split across lines or contain extraction artifacts; formulas in records were therefore normalized manually and kept concise.
Tables and figures were counted from text markers and visually spot-checked on representative rendered pages; embedded diagram geometry was not converted into full graph data.
Exercise prompts were inventoried by number but not reproduced or solved.
limitations: Page anchors use PDF page numbers and book page numbers where main-matter pages are available; line-level anchors are not available inside the generated JSON.
This package is a reasoning map, not a complete theorem/proof database and not a substitute for the book's full text.
Operational extensions for AI agents and applied workflows are explicitly labeled as extensions rather than direct author recommendations.
inspection_actions: Rendered representative pages including cover, copyright page, contents, theorem pages, list pages, and the common-distribution diagram.
Scanned all pages for definition, theorem/lemma/corollary, example, table, figure, and exercise markers.
